data.title: Privacy at Hayame
data.summary: Plain answers about what Hayame knows about you, why, who sees it, how long we keep it and how to take control. This is a guide to our full Privacy Policy, which is the legal document and is published in full at hayamegh.com/privacy.

highlights.title: We do not sell your data
highlights.body: No advertising networks, no data brokers, no tracking you across other apps or websites.

highlights.title: Your ID photos stay private
highlights.body: Licence and face photos are seen only by the Hayame team that reviews them. Never by hosts or other users.

highlights.title: We never see your card
highlights.body: Card and bank details go straight to Paystack. Hayame only keeps the amount, status and reference.

highlights.title: Analytics only if you say yes
highlights.body: Usage analytics is off until you accept it, and you can switch it off again at any time.

questions.q: What information does Hayame collect about me?
a: Account details: your name, email address, phone number and password.
Verification documents: before your first booking, a photo of your face and of the front and back of your driving licence. If you apply to host, a government-issued ID.
Trip information: the cars you view, save and book, your trip dates, the pick-up, delivery or trip area you give us, your booking history and reviews.
Messages: what you and the other party write in the Hayame chat, and what you send to support.
Payment records: the amount, status and reference of each payment. Not your card or bank details.
Device information: an account ID, your device type and app version, and a push notification token so we can send you alerts.

questions.q: Why do you need my driving licence and a photo of my face?
a: To confirm that you are who you say you are, that you are licensed to drive, and that the person collecting the car is the person who booked it. Hosts are trusting you with their car, and this check is what makes that possible. Without it we cannot let you book.

questions.q: Does Hayame track my location?
a: We use the city or area you type in to show you nearby cars. On Android, and only if you give permission, the app can use your phone's location to improve those results; you can turn that off in your phone's settings at any time. The iPhone app does not ask for your location.
Separately, a car you rent may have a GPS tracker fitted by its host. During a trip, the host and Hayame may use it to locate and recover the car. That is the car's location, not your phone's.

questions.q: Does Hayame use my camera and photos?
a: Only when you choose to take or pick a photo: for your profile picture, your verification photos, or pictures of a car you are listing. The app has no access to your camera or photo library at any other time.

questions.q: Do you store my card or mobile money details?
a: No. You enter them on Paystack's secure checkout, and they go to Paystack, not to us. We keep only the record of the payment so we can manage your booking, refunds and disputes.

questions.q: What do you use my information for?
a: To create and secure your account; to make bookings, payments, refunds, messages and reviews work; to verify identities and prevent fraud and unsafe activity; to send you updates about your bookings and account; to give you support; to understand how the service is used so we can fix and improve it; and to meet our legal, tax and accounting duties.

questions.q: Do you sell my data or use it for advertising?
a: No. We do not sell your personal information, we do not share it with advertising networks or data brokers, and we do not track you across other companies' apps or websites. The iPhone app does not use Apple's advertising identifier.

questions.q: What is the analytics choice I was asked about?
a: With your permission, we record how the service is used: which pages and cars are viewed, what is searched for, and where a booking is abandoned. To do that we store a random identifier on your device. It is not your name, your email or an advertising ID, and it is not shared with anyone.
Nothing is recorded until you accept. Saying no does not limit any feature. You can change your mind at any time in Profile, under Privacy, and turning it off deletes the identifier.

questions.q: Does Hayame read my messages?
a: Not routinely. Messages are stored so that both sides have a record of what was agreed. Our team may review a conversation when there is a report, a dispute, or a safety or fraud concern.

questions.q: Are decisions about me made by a computer?
a: No decision that seriously affects you is made by a machine alone. Your verification photos are reviewed by a person, and suspending or closing an account always involves a person.

questions.q: What does the host or renter on the other side see?
a: Only what is needed for the trip: your name and profile photo, the booking details, the messages you send them, and a contact number where it is needed for handover. They never see your licence, your ID, your payment details or your email password.

questions.q: Which companies help Hayame run the service?
a: Supabase stores our database and files and handles sign-in. Paystack processes payments. Resend sends our emails. Apple and Google deliver push notifications. Each of them works under a written agreement, may only use your data to provide that service to us, and must keep it secure.

questions.q: Would you ever give my information to the police or anyone else?
a: Only where the law requires it, for example under a valid legal request, or where it is needed to protect someone's safety, to investigate fraud, or to recover a vehicle. If Hayame were ever sold or merged, your information would move with the service under the same protections.

questions.q: Is my data sent outside Ghana?
a: Hayame operates from Ghana, but some of the companies above store and process data in other countries. Where the law requires, we put safeguards in place so your information keeps the same protection. You can ask us for details.

questions.q: How is my information protected?
a: Data is encrypted while it travels between your phone and our servers. Access is restricted so that each user can only reach their own records, and verification documents are kept in private storage that only authorised team members can open. No system is perfectly secure, but we treat your data as we would want ours treated.

questions.q: How long do you keep my information?
a: Account details: while your account is open, and deleted within 30 days of closing it.
Booking and payment records: as long as Ghanaian tax and accounting law requires, generally up to six years.
Licence, face photo and host ID: only as long as needed to keep you verified and meet our legal and fraud-prevention duties, then securely deleted.
Messages, reviews and support requests: while they are needed to run the service and settle disputes.
Analytics events: up to 400 days.

questions.q: What rights do I have over my data?
a: Under Ghana's Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843), and similar laws elsewhere, you can ask for a copy of the information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, ask us to delete it, object to or restrict certain uses, and withdraw any consent you have given. We will not treat you differently for using these rights.

questions.q: How do I see, correct or download my information?
a: You can edit your name, phone number, city and photo in your profile at any time. For a copy of everything else, or to correct something you cannot change yourself, email support@hayamegh.com from the address on your account. We reply as quickly as we can, and always within the time the law allows.

questions.q: How do I delete my account?
a: Open More in the app and choose Delete account, or email us from the address on your account. We delete your account information within 30 days. We must keep some records, such as past payments, for as long as the law requires, and we cannot close an account that has an active trip or money owing until that is settled.

questions.q: How do I stop notifications or emails?
a: You can choose which push notifications you receive in the app's notification settings, or switch them off in your phone's settings. Emails about your bookings, payments and account security are part of the service and cannot be switched off while you have an account.

questions.q: Can children use Hayame?
a: No. Hayame is for adults aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 18, and we delete it if we learn that we have.

questions.q: Who do I contact with a privacy question or complaint?
a: Email support@hayamegh.com and we will do our best to put it right. If you are not satisfied, you may complain to the Data Protection Commission of Ghana.

questions.q: Will this change?
a: If we change how we handle your information in an important way, we will update the Privacy Policy, change the date at the top, and tell you in the app or by email before the change takes effect.

data.contact: Privacy questions: support@hayamegh.com. The full legal Privacy Policy is at hayamegh.com/privacy.
